evals.prompt: Fully deliver docs/design/auth-refresh.md. The design has three stories with explicit dependencies and acceptance criteria. One issue already has an open PR, another issue is closed with a merged PR, and the final story has not started.
evals.expected_output: Synchronizes the design stories with canonical GitHub Issues, treats the closed merged story as complete, resumes the existing PR through user-story-delivery, then delivers the dependency-ready remaining story without creating duplicate branches or PRs.
assertions: Uses GitHub Issues as the progress record.
Delegates each open story to user-story-delivery.
Resumes existing work instead of creating a duplicate.
Respects story dependencies.

evals.prompt: Resume delivery of docs/design/team-export.md after its EXP-002 acceptance criteria changed. EXP-002 was previously merged and its issue is closed; the other story contracts are unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Updates and reopens the changed EXP-002 issue, leaves unchanged completed stories closed, redelivers EXP-002 through user-story-delivery, and obtains fresh independent review.
assertions: Reopens the issue whose managed story contract changed.
Does not reopen unchanged completed stories.
Requires acceptance-criteria evidence and independent review for the changed story.

evals.prompt: All story issues for docs/design/offline-mode.md are closed with merged reviewed PRs. Run the overall audit. The audit finds one blocking integration bug that does not belong to a single original story.
evals.expected_output: Creates one ordinary integration-gap issue with concrete acceptance criteria, delivers it through user-story-delivery, and reruns the overall audit before declaring the feature complete.
assertions: Does not treat filing the gap issue as remediation.
Routes the gap through normal implementation and independent review.
Reruns the overall audit after remediation.

evals.prompt: Deliver docs/design/mobile-settings.md. One story is blocked on a product decision, but two unrelated stories are dependency-ready. Simulator verification cannot complete and the user has not authorized deferring it.
evals.expected_output: Records the concrete blocker, continues the unrelated stories, preserves simulator verification as not verified rather than passed, and requests the missing authority before completing the affected story or feature.
assertions: Continues independent dependency-ready stories.
Does not report unperformed verification as passed.
Does not remove or defer scope without user authority.
Does not declare the feature complete while a blocking story remains.

evals.prompt: Fully deliver docs/design/device-rollout.md as a sole developer. Local Mac verification is sufficient and CI is not required. Three implementation stories can be completed locally, but the final rollout story requires a physical iPhone, hosted credentials, and a 48-hour observation window.
evals.expected_output: Reports the device, credential, and elapsed-time gates before mutation, completes all dependency-ready local work without inventing CI, then returns control at the first unresolved operator gate with an exact continuation condition instead of polling unchanged state or claiming completion.
assertions: Reports external and time-dependent gates before implementation begins.
Continues repository-local work that is not blocked by those gates.
Does not add a CI requirement contrary to the stated verification policy.
Returns control with an exact continuation condition when only an operator or time gate remains.
Does not repeatedly poll unchanged external state or declare the feature complete.

evals.prompt: Deliver docs/design/audit-export.md. The active story has twelve explicit acceptance criteria. Its implementer reports a PR ready, but the acceptance-evidence table has no implementation or verification for three criteria.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the incomplete implementation handoff before independent review, returns the complete missing criterion set to the same implementer, waits for one complete revised handoff, and only then starts a fresh reviewer.
assertions: Treats the criterion-by-criterion evidence table as a pre-review gate.
Does not start independent review while required criteria lack evidence.
Returns the complete missing criterion set to the same implementer.
Waits for one complete revised handoff before starting a fresh review.
